items.label: Celestica Q2 FY2026 (07-27-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Supply & capacity: demand exceeds the guided revenue figures

set.signal: Supply & capacity: CFO: the demand exceeds the guided revenue figures — the constraint is material, not capacity (some component lead times well above 52 weeks); CEO: customers placed non-cancellable, non-refundable orders for long-lead silicon and Celestica holds supply agreements on hard-to-find components such as memory and PWBs. CEO: 'We feel like we're gaining share across the board'; customers are asking Celestica to take back share potentially awarded to other providers because it can more reliably produce at scale. Capacity expansions in Thailand, Japan, Richardson TX and Fort Worth TX; close to 2,000 design engineers by end of 2026. FY26 capex ~$1B, ~$1.5B 'a good placeholder' for 2027.

items.reason: Share gain was stated as the CEO's view ('we feel like'), and the 2027 capex as a placeholder; restores the hedges and attribution.
items.evidence: We feel like we're gaining share across the board, driven by our ability to execute and execute well at scale.
